rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card and predictions before data; synthetic (gauge curve, churn null, power, S/S0 check); nine kickoff units in eight periods; two room natives (G44, G38); post-hoc design-code test (labelled); per-period estimates (20 rows); confirm.py frozen (#45, #46, #47, #49), not run.
rationale.faithfulness: The pre-registered gauge failed as a measurement (H54 name-token flags do not track specificity) and the primary test is underpowered (0.29). The post-hoc goal-type split is clean (5/5 vs 4/4, p 0.008) but post hoc and close to H75's earlier result. Scorecard A0 B1 C0 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Restates H75's kickoff rule on nine kickoffs: name or assign the artifact and the swarm settles in < 1 active h; open goals take 4-13 h. Useful and simple, but not new, and the slack is a read-out, not a lever.

one_line: Slack does not track the HH's specificity x (rho -0.01, n 9; x itself is invalid: word overlap, not specificity), but separates assigned-artifact goals (S 1.0-2.5, T_e < 1 h) from open goals (S 3-15, T_e 4-13 h) perfectly, post hoc (p 0.008).
